🌙 The Shared Night

When several dreamers dream of the same thing on the same night (a flood, a white horse, a door), it opens in Somnucor the next day as a shared dream everyone can walk into: a ring of moonlight in the Tower Plaza, under a violet beam.

Only the kind of thing in each dream is counted (the catalogue's own word, like "horse" or "flood"), never your words, names or places, and never who dreamt it. Nothing shows until enough different dreamers have dreamt it.
